title: 第10章 春狩第11章 异兽
content_zh:
到了明劲层次，光靠苦练已经是不行了，想要提升修为主要还得靠药补。
他已经打听清楚了，若是服用气血丹，那修炼一次相当于普通人修炼十次，而且一枚的药力就抵得上明劲武者一个月苦修。
若是能有宝肉、宝鱼、宝药等资源，效果还要更强一筹。
“生命星辰虽然神效，但只是让我恢复而非进补。”
“想要快速提升修为，还得要气血丹、宝肉、宝鱼等资源。”
陆沉摇了摇头，他倒是有一百多两白银，但是小寒城的药铺都是属于各大家族。
在展露明劲实力，且处理掉裂石帮这个威胁之前，他也不敢暴露自己有这么多银钱。
“去修仙界？”
陆沉思虑，很快又摇头。
修仙界神秘莫测，修士的手段恐怕不是他现在能对抗的。
关键现在才过去两个月，万一那家伙还在蹲守，一头撞枪口上那就麻烦了。
“再等一段时间，等那韩枫突破明劲之后，我再找个机会展露明劲实力，再想办法把钱花出去提升实力。”
想到这里，陆沉将念头收回，又感应起体内的劲力冲突，不由眉心微微皱起。
铁甲功和裂石拳的劲力，此时正在他的手臂中不断冲突，这两种力量把他体内当成战场，不断冲击他的筋脉和血肉，不断造成暗伤和淤血。
如果没有九玄镜，他唯一办法就是废掉裂石拳的劲力，否则这条手臂怕是会全部废掉。
可如今随着生命力不断恢复，他的伤势却在不断受伤和恢复之中反复拉扯。
“虽然修成明劲二响，但是劲力冲突却是个大问题。”
“能否解决这个问题？”
陆沉心中沉吟，他尝试催动两种劲力，使之不断的融合。
可是两股劲力融合的瞬间，却让陆沉的皮肉炸开，大动脉瞬间崩断成了两截，鲜血喷的满地都是。

“真的无法融合两种劲力么？”
看着断裂的筋脉停止喷涌鲜血，以肉眼可见的速度续接，裂开皮肉转眼恢复如初，陆沉面不改色。
他的眉心微微皱起，又果断地说道：“不可能，既然化境武人能修炼两种劲力，那就没道理我不能融合。”
话音落下，陆沉再次催动两种劲力。
“嘭——”
这一次更加激烈，陆沉的手臂被两股劲力撕成两截，只有骨骼仍在相连。
可是仅仅两个呼吸，这点伤势就彻底恢复了。
“不对，不能蛮干。”
陆沉转变思路，开始缓慢调动劲力，让两股劲力不断地接触，一点点的彼此交融。
如此虽然还是不断造成暗伤，但是却没有那么严重了。
而随着两股劲力不断接触，陆沉开始一点点加大力量，试图让它们不断融合在一起。
如此一来，虽然这两股劲力还没有立即融合，陆沉却发现自己的双臂在两股劲力淬炼之下，逐渐变得越来坚韧强横。
这并非是铁甲功劲力带来的提升，而是他的体质在不断损坏和修复中，逐渐变得适应和更加强大。
“只要我的体魄足够强大，能够承受两股劲力的激烈碰撞，我迟早能将他们彻底融合。”
陆沉心中低语，然后迈步往家中走去。
content_en:
At the level of Ming Jin, hard training alone is no longer enough. If you want to improve your cultivation, you must mainly rely on medicinal supplements.
He has already found out clearly that if you take the Qi and Blood Pill, one practice is equivalent to ten times for ordinary people, and the power of one pill is equivalent to a month of hard training for a Ming Jin warrior.
If there are resources such as precious meat, precious fish, and precious medicine, the effect will be even stronger.
"Although the Life Star is miraculous, it only restores me rather than nourishes me."
"If you want to quickly improve your cultivation level, you need resources such as Qi and Blood Pills, precious meat, and precious fish."
Lu Chen shook his head. He had more than a hundred taels of silver, but the pharmacies in Xiaohan City all belonged to major families.
He didn't dare to reveal that he had so much money before he showed off his strength and dealt with the threat of the Split Stone Gang.
"Go to the world of immortality?"
Lu Shen thought and quickly shook his head.
The world of immortality is mysterious and unpredictable, and the monks' methods may not be something he can resist now.
The key point is that it has only been two months. If that guy is still squatting and hitting the muzzle of the gun, it will be troublesome.
"Wait for a while, after Han Feng breaks through Ming Jin, I will find another opportunity to show Ming Jin's strength, and then find a way to spend money to improve his strength."
Thinking of this, Lu Chen took his thoughts back, and felt the conflict of strength in his body, and couldn't help but frown slightly.
The power of the Iron Armor Technique and the Stone-Splitting Fist were constantly conflicting in his arms. These two powers treated his body as a battlefield, constantly impacting his veins and flesh, causing hidden wounds and congestion.
If there is no Jiuxuan Mirror, his only way is to destroy the power of the Stone Splitting Fist, otherwise this arm may be completely useless.
But now, as his vitality continues to recover, his injuries are repeatedly being injured and recovering.
"Although I have achieved the second ring of Ming Jin, the conflict of powers is a big problem."
"Can this be solved?"
Lu Chen pondered in his heart, and he tried to activate the two powers to continuously integrate them.
But the moment the two forces merged, Lu Chen's skin and flesh exploded, his aorta instantly broke into two pieces, and blood spurted all over the floor.
"Is it really impossible to combine the two powers?"
Lu Chen's expression did not change as he watched the broken tendons stop spewing blood and reconnect at a speed visible to the naked eye, and the cracked flesh returned to its original state in an instant.
His brows furrowed slightly, and he said decisively: "Impossible. Since the transformation warrior can cultivate two kinds of strength, there is no reason why I can't fuse them."
After the words fell, Lu Chen once again activated two kinds of strength.
"Bang——"
This time it was even more intense. Lu Chen's arm was torn into two pieces by two powerful forces, with only the bones still connected.
But in just two breaths, this injury was completely recovered.
"No, you can't be reckless."
Lu Chen changed his mind and began to slowly mobilize his energy, allowing the two forces to continuously contact and blend into each other bit by bit.
Although this still caused hidden injuries, it was not as serious.
As the two forces continued to come into contact, Lu Chen began to increase his strength little by little, trying to make them merge together.
As a result, although the two forces had not yet merged immediately, Lu Chen found that his arms were gradually becoming stronger and stronger under the tempering of the two forces.
This is not an improvement brought about by the strength of the Iron Armor Kung Fu, but rather the fact that his physique is gradually becoming more adaptable and stronger as it is constantly damaged and repaired.
"As long as my body is strong enough and can withstand the fierce collision of the two forces, I will be able to completely fuse them sooner or later."
Lu Chen whispered in his heart, and then walked back home.
